description:
Hi, we're team Lost In Cosmos, bringing you stories from beyond. Join us, in our project we titled "Cosmic Saga", an interactive webapp that highlights and celebrates the journey and the achievements of man made hardware left in the outer space.

Ours is team consisting of like minded and curious individuals who love science and tech, and also happen to come from an engineering background. Joining us are: 

Tayebur Naseef: Team Leader, Coordinator and Graphics Editor.

Tahsin T Nadeed: Researcher, Content Writer and Storyteller.

Hossen Supto: Project and Content Manager.

Zeba Anika: Researcher and Data Analyst.

Ridoy: Programmer and Developer.

Our goal, is to tell compelling and engaging stories about the hardwares abandoned in space that mark the human footprint and represent human intellect and our civilization out in the grand arena of the universe. From the Apollo spacecrafts, to the Mars Rovers, we'll take you on a ride exploring the journey and the scientific discoveries of space missions, and the amazing science and engineering that made them possible, using real data from NASA opensource.

Together, we're team Lost In Cosmos, bringing you enjoyable stories about man made things, that are really, lost in cosmos.

Thank you.
